description: Every real number strictly between 0 and 1 has exactly one decimal digit sequence that is not eventually all 9 and has that real value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.canonical_decimal_expansion {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) :
  ∃! d, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CanonicalDecimal d ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue d = x
